quarterly_data.signal: Planet Labs Germany was awarded a Satellite Services tender by the German Federal Ministry of the Interior (BMI) - per Planet, Germany is the first civil government globally to acquire its dedicated Constellation Services. The Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG) will coordinate and distribute high-resolution tasked imagery, nationwide Planet Mosaics and geospatial analytics to German civil government authorities; Planet will also deliver a cloud-native Software-as-a-Service and platform solution deployed on European cloud infrastructure. The award includes options and has a maximum possible value of EUR 25 million over 5 years and does not change the guidance issued on September 3, 2026; it builds on Planet's relationship with BKG since 2021, through which its data supports more than 400 federal institutions in Germany.
